(4) Add a header or summary line, like "3 todos (1 done)". (5) Show a message like "No todos." when the list is empty. (6) Use ANSI colours, like dimming done items or showing overdue items in red. (7) Something else. Also, is it fine for the current exact output format to change? Existing tests will need updating.
